dialogues.speaker: Izumi Naki
dialogues.text: May it go well with Watatsumi Island this year also...

dialogues.speaker: Izumi Naki
dialogues.text: I am a shrine maiden here at the Sangonomiya Shrine, and the Divine Priestess' wishes are my command.

dialogues.speaker: Izumi Naki
dialogues.text: See you. May Watatsumi Omikami watch over you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could you tell me more about the Divine Priestess?

dialogues.speaker: Izumi Naki
dialogues.text: Her Excellency, Sangonomiya Kokomi, is our Divine Priestess — and our supreme leader.

dialogues.speaker: Izumi Naki
dialogues.text: Her bloodline is very special indeed, and she is the sole heir of Watatsumi Island. Naturally, the people of Sangonomiya Shrine obey her orders.

dialogues.speaker: Izumi Naki
dialogues.text: Her Excellency has both ability and political integrity, and is skilled in many different fields. She is the undisputed leader of Watatsumi Island.

dialogues.speaker: Izumi Naki
dialogues.text: ...Her duties and cares are many, however, and even she must need some space to herself to think quietly.

dialogues.speaker: Izumi Naki
dialogues.text: As such, I would advise that you not disturb her, unless it's something important.
